text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, as I was wandering around the academy grounds,
I heard some solemn background music.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ""~Strange Tales of the Crimson Saint in Another World: Act 14~""

text_block_list.name: Archangel
text_block_list.text: O Saint—O Saint, awaken.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could you be...
the Archangel who summoned me to this world?!

text_block_list.name: Archangel
text_block_list.text:
Crisis has befallen our kingdom once more.
Please... lend us your holy power
and restore peace to our land.

text_block_list.name: Prince of the Crimson Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“—You have arrived, Saint.
I have summoned thee today for none other than this.”

text_block_list.name: Prince of the Crimson Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The miasma generated by the Apostle of Destruction is threatening our realm. Purify it at once!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My Prince... leave it to me.
This, too, is the duty of the summoned Saintess.

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight
text_block_list.text:
"On my knightly honor, I shall protect you.
Please, put your mind at ease!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, having the renowned Holy Knight by my side
is truly reassuring. Now then, let us be off!
choice_data_list: (A skit about being reincarnated as a saint in another world... huh?)
(Is this... a skit about being reincarnated as a saint in another world?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Here it is~! 
I've been waiting for the next chapter of 'Crimson Maiden'~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Prince~! You're just too dreamy and gorgeous again today~!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So you're the one generating this miasma,
one of the God of Destruction's Four Heavenly Kings, Witch of the Dark Broom!

text_block_list.name: Dark Broom Witch
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Saint or whatever, I don't care—if you stand in my way, you're going down!

text_block_list.name: Giant Wolf
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right theeeere!
The one to take down the Saint is yours truly, the Great Wolf!

text_block_list.name: Giant Wolf
text_block_list.text:
"I'll shred 'em to pieces with these ultimate claws
and make the God of Destruction acknowledge me as the strongest of the Four Heavenly Kings!"

text_block_list.name: Dark Broom Witch
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? The strongest of the Heavenly Kings is M-E!
I'm gonna beat that Saintess in no time
and get myself some new magic items!

text_block_list.name: Giant Wolf
text_block_list.text: No! Number one is Great Wolf-chan!!
choice_data_list: (Looks like they're starting to turn on each other...)
(Looks like they're starting to turn on each other, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It is a fact that the kingdom is being threatened by the two of you.
There is no denying that you are both formidable."

text_block_list.name: Giant Wolf
text_block_list.text: I don't want 'both'! Big Wolf has gotta be the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Dark Broom Witch
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm the strongest!
I gotta make that God of Destruction understand!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Then why don't you
prove it to me directly?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Confront the God of Destruction and display our strength.
Doing so will surely make them understand.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is a request from their beloved apostle, after all.
The God of Destruction will surely accept it with grace.

text_block_list.name: Dark Broom Witch
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that would be the quickest way.

text_block_list.name: Giant Wolf
text_block_list.text: "That's a great idea! I'll take it!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself, God of Destruction~!!

text_block_list.name: God of Destruction
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! To bare your fangs at a god!
Yet, I applaud your spirit!!
Now! Show me your potential!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Directly exchanging feelings with all of one's heart and soul...
What a wonderful scene, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Now, all that remains is to cleanse
the lingering miasma with holy power!
Purifying Flash of the Untainted Saint...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the land tainted by darkness has been restored!
To bring back peace without shedding a single drop of blood...
Truly magnificent, Saintess!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, thanks to the Saint,
peace returned to the kingdom once more. ~To be continued~”
(Waaaah! *clap clap clap*)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun again~
Though what an unexpected way to solve it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see more of the God of Destruction~
I wonder what happened to them after that!?
"...I felt swept away by an inexplicable momentum, but I ended up watching it all the way to the end."
choice_data_list: At the end of the day, that was pretty fun...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Oh. So you were watching too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Behold the "Otherworldly Tales of the Scarlet Saint," woven by everyone and me!
choice_data_list: Did Desire come up with that story?
Did Desire come up with that story?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rather than thinking of it,
it would be more accurate to say it came to me naturally.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san is a prince, Pisa-san is an archangel...
Just by looking at you all, your figures in another world
and stories woven with a holy maiden spring to mind.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, we're already on Act 46...
The stories, the participants, and the audience
have all truly grown so much, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. From here on, the wings of imagination will keep spreading,
and tales of other worlds will surely continue to be spun.
choice_data_list: Why are you doing this in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. From here on, the wings of imagination will keep spreading,
and tales of other worlds will surely continue to be spun.
choice_data_list: Why are you doing this in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely...
There are many girls, myself included, who have received the 'Saint's Aid.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, this story began when one of them
offered to help out as a token of gratitude."
choice_data_list: So it was the reward for helping people all this time.
So it was the reward for helping people all this time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A story born from helping and being helped...
What a wonderful miracle.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
When we cross over to "that place," let us pass down the tale.
As a wondrous story woven together in our former world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's a rehearsal for when
I finally cross over to "that land"...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "The trials awaiting the Saint come in infinite forms... With everyone's cooperation, I was preparing so that I might respond splendidly when facing them."
choice_data_list: In other words, an isekai simulation?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to everyone, my preparations
for crossing over to "that land" are complete!
